description: Endaoment 'Create async grant' (OpenAPI 4.88.0) request and response, assembled from per-field examples, converted

field_provenance.source_snippet: id: type: string description: Unique identifier of the transfer format: uuid example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
field_provenance.note: Every uuid example in the OpenAPI is the same placeholder, so grant, fund and org ids coincide here

field_provenance.source_snippet: originFundId: type: string description: ID of the fund that is the origin of the grant format: uuid example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
destinationOrgId: type: string description: ID of the organization that will receive the grant format: uuid example: 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426614174000
description: Unique identifier of the organization in Endaoment database
field_provenance.note: Scheme label 'x-endaoment-org-uuid' assigned by the converter

field_provenance.source_snippet: description: IRS Employer Identification Number (EIN) without hyphen example: '530196605'
field_provenance.note: Response-side example; the OpenAPI's per-field examples are independent, so the pairing of this EIN with the uuid is an assembly [I]

field_provenance.source_snippet: The amount in USDC to be granted, in the smallest currency unit (1000000 = 1 USD) example: '1000000'
field_provenance.note: USDC smallest unit (1000000 = 1 USD) to a two-decimal USD string; non-cent amounts are rejected, not rounded
[I] USDC is recorded as USD at the 1:1 rate the OpenAPI states; the record does not model stablecoins

field_provenance.source_snippet: description: Public declaration of the grant purpose maxLength: 511 example: Supporting educational programs

field_provenance.note: Free text only. An education subject code exists in PCS but its code value could not be read first-hand (full code list robots-blocked), so none is assigned

field_provenance.source_snippet: example: Funds must be used exclusively for the summer education program
field_provenance.source_value: Funds must be used exclusively for the summer education program

field_provenance.source_snippet: Set by the user recommending the grant. default: false
field_provenance.note: [I] shareMyEmail defaults to false (email withheld) while recommender carries a name ('John Doe'), read as name_only

field_provenance.source_snippet: description: Current status of the async transfer request enum: - PendingLiquidation - Liquidated - Cancelled example: pending
field_provenance.note: The OpenAPI's example 'pending' is not in its own enum; the documented value PendingLiquidation would also map to pending

field_provenance.source_snippet: description: UTC timestamp when the transfer was created format: date-time example: '2024-03-20T10:30:00Z'
description: UTC timestamp when the transfer was last updated format: date-time example: '2024-03-20T10:30:00Z'
description: Transaction hash of the donation made to the target entity example: '0x1234567890abcdef'
field_provenance.note: Nullable in the OpenAPI; kept because the example supplies it

field_provenance.source_snippet: Transaction hash of the donation made to the target entity
field_provenance.note: Rail 'onchain' inferred from the hash field
Endaoment is the sponsor; its EIN is not in the payload
Approval status is no longer exposed: status (PendingReview/Approved/Rejected) is deprecated (wave 40A)

source_fields_not_carried: idempotencyKey (transaction-API concern, not part of a published record)
recommender (the name itself; only its presence drives anonymity)
destinationOrg.* other than ein (name, address, nteeCode, ...)

record.restriction_text: Funds must be used exclusively for the summer education program
